root_idea.summary: The root centers on making something perceptible by exposing, declaring, or raising it, especially through visible manifestation or audible speech.
root_idea.development: The semantic range develops from becoming conspicuous or perceptible to public disclosure, loud utterance, direct visibility, prominence, and related notions of bringing something into the open or making it emerge.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Form I verb with Quranic uses involving public disclosure and audible speech.
Distinct Quranic verbal noun denoting public manifestation and loudness.
Distinct Quranic noun/adverbial form denoting unconcealed or direct perception.
Distinct Quranic adverbial noun meaning publicly or openly.

senses.definition: To make something public, disclose it, or state it openly.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, the object is speech or an utterance, including what is publicly stated as opposed to what is concealed.

senses.definition: To utter aloud or raise the voice.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of speech, prayer, recitation, or voice when it is made plainly audible or louder rather than kept quiet.

senses.definition: Public or open disclosure; what is made manifest or openly stated.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, it may denote publicly expressed speech or anything disclosed in contrast with what is hidden.

senses.definition: Loudness or raised audibility of speech.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of speech or voice that is made plainly audible or louder.

senses.definition: Openly, plainly, or visibly, without concealment or an intervening veil.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, especially in the expression of seeing something directly or having it occur openly; the form is adverbial in these contexts.
An adverbial noun used with public speech or calling, contrasting with secrecy or concealment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become plain, apparent, conspicuous, open, or public; more emphatically, to become readily perceptible to sight or hearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing a thing becoming conspicuous or perceptible, distinct from the Quranic transitive uses of publicly uttering speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become great or bulky, and thereby conspicuous before the beholder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person or object whose size makes it prominent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a voice: to rise, become high, or become loud; of a person: to have a high or loud voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive vocal-quality use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be unable or weak to see in sunlight; of the sun, to dazzle the eye and confuse the sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, eye, or the effect of sunlight on vision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make known what was concealed, including one's wrongdoing, inner thoughts, a hidden story, or an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized disclosure construction, broader than ordinary public speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discover or see something with the eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive ocular-perception use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To see or regard someone directly, without a veil intervening; to consider someone worthy of notice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe direct visual regard or recognition of a person's standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard someone as great, and consequently treat that person with reverence, respect, or honor; also to be pleased by beauty or appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A perception-based evaluative use applied to persons or their appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To see an army or people as numerous or imposing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic visual-assessment use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clear a well of its black, fetid mud; to exhaust or nearly exhaust its water; or to reach and expose its water while digging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to wells and their clearing or excavation; the resulting water is described as appearing clear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come upon people in the morning while they are unaware.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression for arriving at dawn or early morning upon unsuspecting people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To traverse land without knowledge or awareness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage concerning movement through land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shake a milk-skin to produce butter and take the butter out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to churning or extracting butter from a milk-skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fight face to face or show open enmity or hostility toward another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal or interpersonal construction of overt confrontation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recite or speak aloud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to audible recitation, speech, or loud speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie with or strive to overcome another in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Classical usage whose wording is accompanied by a textual note suggesting possible transcriptional corruption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beget sons described as goodly in stature or aspect, or, in one reported description, a squint-eyed son.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV usage attributed to particular lexical authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show oneself openly, act openly, or conduct oneself openly with others; also to display mutual hostility openly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or reflexive Form VI construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign inability to see in the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VI usage linked to the solar-vision branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take something forth or bring it out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form X usage, distinct from the pointer to other meanings of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blaze covering the face of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of a horse's facial marking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cast or defect in the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use distinct from the Quranic adverbial جَهْرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An army seen as numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal descriptive use applied to an army.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bold or daring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High, loud, or vehement speech or voice; a person possessing such a voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of speech, voice, or its speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasing or goodly in aspect, with a beautiful or well-formed appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, face, or body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adapted or constituted for goodness and beneficence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use, especially in the expressions جَهِيرٌ لِلْخَيْرِ and جَهِيرٌ لِلْمَعْرُوفِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk that has not been mixed with water, or from which the butter has been taken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use applied to milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasingness or goodliness of aspect, outward appearance, or form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal quality of a person's appearance, sometimes extended to what pleases by its beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Public behavior or outward conduct, as opposed to secret conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the fixed expression contrasting public behavior with inward or secret conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A jewel, precious stone, gem, pearl, or native ore from which something useful is extracted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized noun whose derivation from this root is debated in the source tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The diversified wavy marks, streaks, or grain of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for the patterned surface of a sword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The essence, substance, or constitutive basis of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical philosophical sense for what a thing's constitution is based upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An indivisible atom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical, figurative extension of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Substance as opposed to accident.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional scholastic-theological sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A jeweller or seller of jewels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived occupational noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to substance as opposed to accident.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical scholastic adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a prominent, large, or conspicuous eyeball.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or to an eye, with a corresponding feminine form in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a pleasing or attractive cast in the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical-description use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unable or weak to see in sunlight or daytime.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, ram, or eye; distinct from inability to see at night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse: having a blaze covering the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Open, bare, or plain land without concealing trees, hills, or sands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to unobstructed terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The distinguished or most excellent members of a people or tribe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for the notable part of a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person accustomed to speaking in a plain, open, or public voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument-pattern noun describing a habitual speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Notorious, plain, apparent, or conspicuous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a thing or person as the result of being publicly known or clearly manifest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A voiced letter, pronounced with the voice rather than breath alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical phonetic term opposed to مَهْمُوس.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water drawn from the earth after having been buried in it, so that it has become sweet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well cleared and cleansed of its black, fetid mud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine nominal description of a cleaned well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wells that are frequented or in use, whether their water is sweet or saline.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural or collective use concerning wells.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who feigns inability to see in the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial use connected with the specialized solar-vision branch.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Independent intransitive meaning of becoming conspicuous or perceptible.

cautions: The Quranic جَهْرَة usage is associated with direct or unconcealed perception, while the lexical discussion also records alternative grammatical analyses of the form.

The reported Form III usage meaning to vie or strive to overcome is retained as a Classical branch because it is stated lexically, but the source text notes that its wording may reflect transcriptional corruption.
The etymology of جَوْهَر is disputed in the lexical evidence: it is connected by one account with this root and by another with Persian.
